observations.triggers: TriggerManager persists rule definitions and lastRunAt. Scheduled runs create WorkTasks. Desktop bridge reconstructs executionInput from task goal, omitting webhookPayload. Scheduling needs desktop running or runner --watch. No durable generic retry queue; WhatsApp has a separate queue.
observations.teams: TeamExecutionEngine has sequential/parallel steps and typed conditions, validates DAG, merges output objects into shared context, stops on sequential failure. State is in memory. Delegation calls an agent and returns its output, records an audit edge.
observations.review: WorkManager stores versions and accept/revise statuses. Tool actions have separate approvals. No enforced chain assigning QA and routing QA rejection to original developer.
observations.connectors: Composio generic search/execute and MCP exist. No native Google Ads/Meta campaign typed models, experimental outcomes or campaign change evidence found. Actual account permissions not tested.

claims.complete_pipeline: The app can reliably run incoming complaint to developer to QA to merge-ready PR unattended today.
claims.analysis: Daily lead analysis can be configured with an accessible data source and a running host, but business recommendations are not a proven continuous improvement loop.
claims.ads: Generic connectors alone establish production-ready daily autonomous Google/Meta optimization.
